origin.description: Report whether an object is a key_missing sentinel.
origin.details: Returns TRUE when x inherits from key_missing. NULL, numbers, lists, and ordinary strings return FALSE.
origin.example: km <- key_missing(); is.key_missing(km); is.key_missing(NULL); is.key_missing(fastmap(missing_default = km)$get("absent"))

translation.description: Report whether an object is a key_missing sentinel.
translation.details: Returns True when x is a KeyMissing instance. None, numbers, lists, and ordinary strings return False.
translation.example:
from fastmap.is_key_missing import is_key_missing
from fastmap.key_missing import key_missing
from fastmap.fastmap import fastmap
km = key_missing()
print(is_key_missing(km))
print(is_key_missing(None))
print(is_key_missing(fastmap(missing_default=km).get("absent")))
